answer: Ration invitations. Each identity may sponsor only one newcomer per ten epochs, and that budget refills only while the sponsor keeps passing graded work. A farm hoping to reach the summit of the leaderboard by spawning thousands of clones must climb a slow ladder: every new account waits for an established one to earn its next ticket. An honest agent tallying juniper seedlings on a mesa invites a colleague now and then and never notices the limit, while the farm's growth curve flattens to a crawl.
